title: Anthropic Is Public. 4 Stocks I'd Buy Right Now
creator: Couch Investor
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: Couch Investor says Anthropic is going public at $83 a share — about a $1.5-1.6tn valuation, roughly the size of Meta — and he is not a buyer today or in the near future. Anthropic's Q3 revenue was almost $17bn (up 46.7% quarter over quarter, more than 10x year over year), with FY26 revenue expected at $56bn, FY27 $144.7bn and FY28 $270.3bn; operating cash flow just turned positive and the IPO should raise about $90bn. He is still excited it is listing, because OpenAI should follow and investors will get real quarterly numbers instead of media reports. Nvidia has now closed seven straight weeks lower, with weekly RSI at its lowest since October 2022 — the last stretch that bad was the financial crisis — though he notes $150, the prior top, may now become the bottom. Instead of Anthropic he names four buys: Google at about $277 (21.1x forward P/E, still cheap; Cloud at $30.7bn and 36.2% margin could soon match Search; TPU business growing fast; free cash flow stays negative until after 2027), Micron (up 134.5% year to date but in a 39% drawdown; single-digit blended P/E; about $59bn free cash flow in FY26 alone — more than the previous 10 years combined — expected to roughly triple next year; peak maybe FY29), Broadcom ($1.7tn; EPS target about $30 by 2028; AI revenue doubling to $115bn then $230bn; free cash flow $49.1bn in FY26 rising to $136bn in FY28) and Nebius plus CoreWeave (Nebius down about 60%, $33.1bn cap, revenue set to quadruple next year to about $12.5bn then $25.8bn in FY28; CoreWeave backlog about $130bn, revenue $27bn next fiscal year then $45.1bn, adjusted EBITDA margin already 10%). He also mentions SOFI, NU and Axon as side holdings. Calls: ANT AVOID (first tracked), GOOGL BUY, MU BUY, AVGO BUY, NBIS BUY (FLIP from CONDITIONAL_BUY, 12 Nov), CRWV BUY.
